Three anomalies were flagged around the April 2020 peak (~61.88). The article's context events (Q3 earnings on Dec 8 2021, fulfillment center investment, balance sheet improvement) were all rejected by the ablation gate because their dates fall outside the price history window. Both history-only and event-informed runs produced identical ETS forecasts. The forecast captures the ongoing downward trajectory.
